title: Conormal torsion for a one-dimensional completed component
statement: Let $(A,\mathfrak m)$ be a Noetherian local domain, let $B=\widehat A$ be its maximal-ideal completion, and let $\mathfrak q$ be a minimal prime of $B$ with $\dim(B/\mathfrak q)=1$. There exist integers $n,c\ge1$ such that, for $J=\mathfrak q^n$, one has $JB_{\mathfrak q}=0$ and $(\mathfrak mB)^c(J/J^2)=0$. Here $J/J^2$ is the quotient of the ideal $J$, viewed as a $B$-module, by its squared ideal.
